summary: Current main still captures one full decode CUDAGraph per shape and performs one replay for target verify; no split_nlayers configuration or layer-split backend is present. The reported NVIDIA cudaGraphLaunch host-latency behavior could not be reproduced or evaluated on the assigned single AMD gfx950 GPU. No implementation change was made because the proposed two-graph design requires issue-specific performance and correctness evidence on the affected GLM-5.1 FP8/MTP, CUDA, and TP=8 path.

tests.what_was_measured: Existing full-graph capture hooks and CUDA-graph configuration unit coverage; 5 passed and 226 were deselected. This is structural coverage, not the reported performance reproduction.

A 512-operation torch.cuda.CUDAGraph fixture executed on the assigned AMD MI355X. Output agreed with an independent float64 closed-form reference (maximum absolute error 9.75328668e-06; allclose rtol/atol 2e-5), and replay observed a mutated static input (maximum absolute error 2.37463503e-06). This validates local HIP graph execution only.

tests.command: gh issue view 29960 --repo sgl-project/sglang --json state,title,comments,updatedAt,url; gh search prs 'split_nlayers repo:sgl-project/sglang'; gh search code 'split_nlayers repo:sgl-project/sglang'
tests.what_was_measured: The source issue remained open, with no split_nlayers pull request or code-search result found at investigation time.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-634920cfc913/gpu_graph_check.txt records execution on AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015. It is not CUDA/H200 evidence.

remaining_limitations: The assigned hardware is one AMD MI355X (gfx950) using HIP; the report concerns NVIDIA H200 CUDA 13.0 host-side cudaGraphLaunch behavior.
The GLM-5.1-FP8 weights were not available locally, and the reported EAGLE/MTP target-verify architecture was not run.
TP=8, NCCL world-size 8 behavior cannot be reproduced with the assigned single GPU.
No profiler comparison of one full graph versus two layer-split graphs was possible, so launch overlap and latency benefit remain unverified.
The prepared checkout is a single-commit graft, so current source and GitHub issue/PR/code searches were inspected, but local historical archaeology is unavailable.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture was not used because it cannot qualify GLM-5.1/MTP architecture behavior or the distributed CUDA launch-cost claim.
